verdict.rationale: Omarchy's docs say its default firewall leaves port 53317 open specifically for LocalSend, a local-network file-sharing app. That suggests a pre-configured wireless file-transfer path between nearby devices. It is only an indirect, single mention: the docs never describe a file-sending workflow, and nothing covers pairing or Bluetooth. Missing for 10: explicit docs that LocalSend ships and how to send files, pairing or Bluetooth transfer, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can send files wirelessly between nearby paired devices

citations.quote: Firewall is enabled by default: All incoming traffic by default except for port 22 for ssh and port 53317 for LocalSend.
